shortDescription: Manage sysctl entries on OpenWrt targets

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Ignore errors when the sysctl key is unknown.

options.name: reload
options.description: Whether to reload the sysctl configuration after making changes. Only applies when O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the sysctl entry should be present or absent in the configuration file.

options.name: sysctl_file
options.description: The sysctl configuration file to modify.

options.name: sysctl_set
options.description: Whether to set the value in the running kernel. If V(false), only the configuration file is modified.

options.name: value
options.description: The value to set for the sysctl key. Required when O(state=present).
